job.job_description:
We are looking for a Full-Stack AI Developer / Full-Stack AI Engineer with 3 5 years of hands-on experience in building production-ready AI applications. The candidate should have strong experience in Python, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, backend development, frontend development, APIs, vector databases, cloud deployment, and production debugging. The role involves building conversational agents, knowledge assistants, workflow automation agents, and realtime/voice AI systems for internal and client-facing products. The candidate should be able to work across the complete stack, including database design, backend APIs, AI logic, RAG pipelines, tool calling, frontend UI, deployment, monitoring, and production support. We are looking for someone who can build real products, not just prompts or demos.



Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
